title: 打电话与发消息
goal: 接打电话时会自报身份、找人、请对方重复、留言、挂断，也会写简单的英文消息。
tips: 电话开头：Hi, this is ...（不说 I am ...）。找人：Is Tom there? / Can I speak to Tom?
信号不好：Sorry, you're breaking up. / I can't hear you very well. Can I call you back?
常见消息缩写：BTW = by the way（顺便说一下），ASAP = as soon as possible（尽快），LOL（笑死）。

exchanges.reply: Hi, this is Mei from the bookstore.

exchanges.hearZh: 抱歉，你的声音断断续续的。
exchanges.reply: Let me call you back in a minute.

exchanges.hear: I think you have the wrong number.
exchanges.reply: Oh, I'm sorry to bother you.

exchanges.hear: He's not here right now. Can I take a message?
exchanges.reply: Yes, please tell him Mei called.
exchanges.replyZh: 好的，请告诉他小梅打过电话。

exchanges.hear: I saw a missed call from you. What's up?
exchanges.hearZh: 我看到你的未接来电，什么事？
exchanges.reply: I just wanted to ask about tomorrow's plan.
exchanges.replyZh: 我就是想问问明天的安排。

exchanges.reply: OK, I'll text you the address.
exchanges.replyZh: 好，我把地址发短信给你。

exchanges.hear: Can we do a video call tonight?
I have to go now. Talk to you later.

lines.en: Hi, this is Lin. Is Kate there?
lines.zh: 你好，我是小林。凯特在吗？

lines.en: Sorry, she's out right now. Can I take a message?
lines.zh: 抱歉，她出去了。要留言吗？

lines.en: Yes, please. Can you ask her to call me back?
lines.zh: 好的，麻烦让她给我回个电话。

lines.en: Sure. Does she have your number?
I think so, but just in case, it's one three six, oh oh eight eight, one two three four.
Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you say that again?
lines.zh: 抱歉，信号不好。能再说一遍吗？

lines.en: One three six, double oh, double eight, one two three four.
Got it. I'll tell her as soon as she gets back.
lines.zh: 记下了。她一回来我就告诉她。
